description: This script manages external web dependencies for a project, including downloading and installing packages, with a class WebDependency for handling individual dependencies.

classes.name: WebDependency
classes.description: Represents a web dependency with methods for downloading, extracting, and printing status.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads all dependencies in the list.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs all dependencies in the list by extracting them.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Prints an error message and terminates the script.
